entities.name: János Bóka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Bóka is a Hungarian politician serving as minister for European Union affairs since 2023. He previously worked as a professor at the National University of Public Service, the Károli Gáspár University of the Reformed Church in Hungary, and the Faculty of Law and Public Administration of the University of Szeged. He is a former member of the Alliance of Free Democrats.
